versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00147 The RTE shall pass time-out notifications to the SW-Cs according to the configured aliveTimeout values in the NonqueuedReceiverComSpec . Depending on the configuration of the COM module following rules shall apply: • ComSignal . ComTimeout / ComSignalGroup . ComTimeout configured to 0: No time-out notifications shall occur. • ComSignal . ComTimeout / ComSignalGroup .
